claims.claim: NVIDIA introduced DSX POD, cutting deployment of Vera Rubin AI factories at a prepared site from six months to as little as 14 days.
claims.episode_span: cutting onsite deployment from six months to as little as fourteen days
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Introduces DSX POD AI Factories to Accelerate Europe’s Infrastructure Deployment
claims.supporting_quote: The units arrive ready to connect out of the box to a prepared site’s power, cooling, networking and other supporting infrastructure, reducing deployment time from six months to as little as 14 days.

claims.claim: At 2-gigawatt scale, NVIDIA says DSX can save 54 million liters of water a day, equivalent to the daily use of 180,000 households.
claims.episode_span: at 2-gigawatt scale the design can save 54 million liters of water a day
claims.source_title: European Ecosystem Builds World’s Most Efficient AI Factories With NVIDIA DSX
claims.supporting_quote: At 2-gigawatt scale, NVIDIA DSX can save 54 million liters of water a day compared with conventional cooling-tower-based systems — equivalent to the daily water use of 180,000 households.

claims.claim: DSX MaxLPS is described as helping operators generate the same number of tokens with up to 30 percent less power.
claims.episode_span: helping operators generate the same number of tokens with up to 30 percent less power
claims.source_title: European Ecosystem Builds World’s Most Efficient AI Factories With NVIDIA DSX
claims.supporting_quote: DSX MaxLPS dynamically allocates power within an AI factory’s provisioned budget, helping operators generate the same number of tokens with up to 30% less power.

claims.claim: Lambda’s proof of concept on HGX B200 systems with DSX MaxLPS showed 24 percent more cluster token throughput and 19 percent more GPU capacity within a fixed power budget.
claims.episode_span: Lambda reported 24 percent more cluster token throughput and 19 percent more GPU capacity
claims.source_title: European Ecosystem Builds World’s Most Efficient AI Factories With NVIDIA DSX
claims.supporting_quote: In a proof of concept across NVIDIA HGX™ B200 systems with DSX MaxLPS, Lambda demonstrated 24% more cluster token throughput and 19% more GPU capacity within a fixed power budget.

claims.claim: NVIDIA Sentry quarantines and stops an agent that leaves its software boundary in milliseconds and can boost agent capacity by up to 20 percent.
claims.episode_span: Sentry quarantines and stops it in milliseconds
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Launches OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe AI Agents
claims.supporting_quote: if an agent attempts to move outside its software boundary, NVIDIA Sentry quarantines and stops it in milliseconds. NVIDIA Sentry, powered by DOCA and running on BlueField-4, boosts agent capacity by up to 20%.

claims.claim: After a trial of 30,000 employees, NHS England said in June 2026 it would make Copilot available to as many as 505,000 staff, and participants reported saving 43 minutes a working day.
claims.episode_span: make Microsoft Copilot available to as many as 505,000 clinicians and support staff
claims.supporting_quote: Copilot available to as many as 505,000 clinicians and support staff. Participants in the trial reported saving an average of 43 minutes per working day
